response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong web/backend depth, a genuine mentoring and community-teaching track record, and some exposure to high-throughput distributed systems (Sociomantic/dunnhumby, millions of HTTP requests per second). However, the role's core hard requirement — 8 years of C++ programming — is not met; his documented C/C++ work is roughly six months at National Instruments plus an academic thesis project, with the bulk of his career in TypeScript/Node.js and D. He also lacks demonstrable experience building or leading an internal cloud compute platform at scale, and no formal technical-lead title or team-leadership scope is shown. Strong generalist, but a poor match for this specific systems/C++ leadership profile.
strengths: Broad 15+ year full-stack career across web, mobile, embedded and infrastructure
Real low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems work at Sociomantic/dunnhumby
Proven mentor and educator: workshops, courses, conference talks, OSS projects
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ vs. the 8-year minimum
No evidence of large-scale cloud compute platform ownership or architecture
No formal technical leadership role or cross-team project management scope

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud/compute platform architecture experience
